name: change-impact-assessment
description: Assess the impact of a proposed change across stakeholders, systems, processes, data, training, compliance, risk. Dimensions: magnitude + reach + reversibility + urgency. Uses ADKAR or Prosci frames where helpful. Produces impact matrix + affected parties + risk-adjusted recommendations + go/no-go inputs. Not organizational-change execution — hand off to training / comms / support-rollback skills.
